URL: https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/report/global_oil.php
EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook, published 7 July 2026.
"production shut-ins averaged 8.3 million barrels per day (b/d) in June after peaking at 11.2 million b/d in May."
"the closure of the strait, a major world oil transit chokepoint, significantly disrupted global oil flows resulting in oil price volatility."
Strait of Hormuz closed 28 February to mid-June 2026.
Brent forecasts: June 2026 average $85/b; Q4 2026 forecast $70/b (down $19/b from the June forecast); 2027 average $65/b ($15/b lower than June STEO).
Following the 18 June memorandum of understanding, "reports indicate a significant uptick in tanker traffic moving through the region to both load and deliver crude oil and petroleum products."
EIA expects "most crude oil production and trade patterns to return to near pre-conflict levels by the end of this year, with an average of 1.4 million b/d of supply still shut-in in 4Q26."
